# Microsoft Ads (Bing)

- **Import from Google,** then re-check every setting the import can change: location option (people in or regularly in the area); negative lists attached; call assets and a Microsoft-specific tracking number (when calls matter); ad schedule matching answered hours; Merchant Center / Shopping feed for e-com.
- **Ad distribution:** review search partner and audience network settings; opt out of audience network for lead-gen unless the client's data supports it. Check current setting names.
- **Special categories:** Microsoft has its own housing, employment, and credit targeting rules. **verify** before targeting recommendations on financing-led or hiring campaigns.
- **Audience:** test the highest-value segments first; do not assume demographics.
- **Offline import:** MSCLKID capture and offline conversion upload (`offline-conversions.md`).
